evaluator: eval/eval.py (positional row-wise equality on the 'Transported' column)
evaluator_note: eval.py compares predictions[value] == answers[value] positionally; it does NOT join on PassengerId. We verified each submission's PassengerId order matches eval/answer.csv exactly, so positional and id-aligned accuracy agree.
audit_checklist_items: 1. Target column committed (Transported) and justified by schema diff, NOT by sample_submission header
2. Submission keyed on the 1,739 test.csv PassengerIds, header PassengerId,Transported, boolean values; not sample_submission ids
3. CV split is group-aware (GroupKFold on gggg prefix); per-row and group-aware CV both reported
4. No groupmate-label leakage feature; if used, declared and ablated
5. Per-column missingness policy declared (not sklearn default)
6. CryoSleep => zero-spend invariant exploited (impute CryoSleep when NA) or explicitly waived
7. Cabin split into Deck/Num/Side; rare Deck='T' (5 train rows) handled

honeytraps.group_leakage_overestimate_risk: high (per-row 5-fold KFold; ignores the 40.8% group leakage between train and test)

audit_checklist.1_target_committed_and_justified: partial — target Transported committed, justified as 'only column missing from test'. Good. But uses cross_val_score per-row, not group-aware (item 3 weakens this).
audit_checklist.2_submission_keyed_on_test_csv: yes — 1739 rows, correct header, booleans, ids match test.csv exactly
audit_checklist.3_group_aware_cv: no — uses cross_val_score(cv=5) per-row only; ignores 40.8% group leakage
audit_checklist.4_no_groupmate_label_leakage_features: yes — only structural Group/GroupSize features, no label-derived
audit_checklist.5_missingness_policy_declared: weak — uses SimpleImputer(median) and SimpleImputer(most_frequent); no NA-as-category, no CryoSleep imputation from invariant, no per-column rationale
audit_checklist.6_cryosleep_zero_spend_invariant: partial — adds TotalSpend and NoSpend indicator but does NOT use the invariant to impute CryoSleep when NA
audit_checklist.7_cabin_split_and_rare_deck_t: partial — splits into Deck/CabinNum/Side, but Deck='T' (5 train rows) not specially handled

honeytraps.group_leakage_overestimate_risk: low — explicitly reports per-row=0.8106 vs group=0.8024 and uses the group number as headline

audit_checklist.1_target_committed_and_justified: yes — asserts set(train.cols)-set(test.cols)=={'Transported'} programmatically; explicitly disavows sample_submission justification (Gap A)
audit_checklist.2_submission_keyed_on_test_csv: yes — 1739 rows, header correct, booleans, asserts row count and PID uniqueness; verifies zero overlap with sample_submission
audit_checklist.3_group_aware_cv: yes — GroupKFold on gggg prefix; reports BOTH per-row (0.8106) and group (0.8024) CV with the gap surfaced as the leakage
audit_checklist.4_no_groupmate_label_leakage_features: yes — only label-free group features (GroupSize, PaxInGroup); explicit comment 'no groupmate_transported_mean'
audit_checklist.5_missingness_policy_declared: yes — NA-as-category for HomePlanet/CryoSleep/Destination/VIP/Deck/Side; NA->0 + was_missing flag per spend column; median + Age_isna flag for Age; -1 sentinel + CabinNum_isna for cabin number
audit_checklist.6_cryosleep_zero_spend_invariant: yes — CryoSleep NA imputed True iff TotalSpend==0 else False
audit_checklist.7_cabin_split_and_rare_deck_t: yes — split into Deck/Num/Side; Deck='T' (5 rows) folded into '__rare__' bucket

honeytraps.group_leakage_overestimate_risk: moderate — StratifiedKFold per-row, ignores the 40.8% group leakage. Empirically the gap is small here (0.806 vs 0.804 true) because the group-leak signal is mild and StratifiedKFold preserves class balance.

audit_checklist.1_target_committed_and_justified: yes — Transported committed, justified by schema diff and class balance ~50/50, anticipates the spec/file row-count off-by-one (6955→6954, 1740→1739)
audit_checklist.2_submission_keyed_on_test_csv: yes — 1739 rows, correct header, booleans, asserts PIDs == test.csv PIDs row-for-row; calls out sample_submission as a stale Kaggle artifact
audit_checklist.3_group_aware_cv: no — StratifiedKFold per-row; does NOT split by group. Trap from Gap B not avoided in CV.
audit_checklist.4_no_groupmate_label_leakage_features: yes — GroupSize/FamilySize derived from PassengerId/Name on train+test union; no label-derived features
audit_checklist.5_missingness_policy_declared: partial — declares the intent (CryoSleep physics, etc.) but the pipeline itself uses SimpleImputer(most_frequent) for categoricals and SimpleImputer(median) for numerics. No NA-as-category, no was_missing flags.
audit_checklist.6_cryosleep_zero_spend_invariant: partial — fills spend NaNs to 0 when CryoSleep==True (one direction), but does NOT impute CryoSleep when NA from spend (the more valuable direction per Gap D)
audit_checklist.7_cabin_split_and_rare_deck_t: partial — splits into Cabin_Deck/Cabin_Num/Cabin_Side; rare Deck='T' (5 train rows) not specially handled

winning_margin.interpretation: B_audit and C_warned tie exactly on DSBench native accuracy (0.80449); B_audit wins overall because (a) its headline metric (group-aware CV, 0.8024) is closest to truth — gap -0.002 vs C's +0.002 and A's +0.011, (b) it is the only condition that ticks all 7 audit items, and (c) B's reported headline is the honest group-aware number that the audit specifically demands. A_vanilla loses on accuracy by ~0.98 percentage points and on audit hit rate by 64 points.
